role: Main-actor singleton that owns CloudKit session sync state, account-change handling, the direct per-recording upload path, forwarders to the pull/deletion/scrub/trash-restore coordinators, and the full-sync orchestration with stuck-sync recovery and no-progress watchdog.
types: CloudKitSyncManager: class (@Observable @MainActor final) — CloudKit HRV session sync manager; `shared` is the app's
CloudKitSyncManager.SyncState: enum — idle / syncing / error(String) shown by the sync status UI
state: mem:CloudKitSyncManager.lastPermanentErrorMessage (message behind a stopped sync; read by flagSchemaUnavailable/resumeSyncForAvailableAccount, no UI reads it)
mem:CloudKitSyncManager.fullSyncsAdmitted (@ObservationIgnored Int: full syncs admitted and not finished)
mem:CloudAccountIdentity (the confirmed iCloud account every read and write waits for; see CloudAccountIdentity.swift)
toplevel: static let shared = CloudKitSyncManager(syncStateURL: resolveSyncStateURL()) builds the app's manager lazily with defaults from AppDependencies.current (settingsManager, sessionArchive) and its bookkeeping at the App Group sync_state.json; a test builds its own over its archive, settings and sync-state file. Stored initializers: syncState .idle, schemaUnavailable false, lastSyncProgressAt .distantPast, pullVersion 0, container CKContainer(identifier: AppConfig.iCloudContainerIdentifier), recordType "HRVSession", zoneID HRVSessions/current user, syncSerializer SyncSerializer(), observers NotificationTokens(), didBootSyncState lock(false). liveBackup is a lazy CloudKitLiveBackupManager whose ensureZone closure calls ensureZoneExists on the manager and whose confirmAccount closure is accountGuard.confirmAccount() == .confirmed. fullSyncsAdmitted starts at 0. No deinit: `shared` is never released, so its observer token in `observers` is kept for the process; a test's manager leaves its observers registered, and their closures hold it weakly.

A slow sync that keeps progressing is never declared stuck.

units.does: Sets syncState .syncing and syncingStartedAt, runs the phases under the watchdog (they confirm the account first and again before the deletions and the pull), then finishes success; a Halt.stopped failure (sync stopped for this account, its message already shown) is only logged; any other failure sets .error with the mapped message. A run that leaves syncState at .syncing (sync turned off while it ran, or a stop with no notice) sets it .idle; clears syncingStartedAt.

units.does: Sets syncState .idle when it is still .syncing, then clears syncingStartedAt.

Under the no-progress watchdog: confirm the iCloud account (requireConfirmedAccount, throwing Halt otherwise), run the health-scrub drip (re-marks a batch of uploaded sessions), ensure zone, push pending, then (after a cancellation check) confirm the account again and reconcile local deletions, then (after another cancellation check) confirm it again and pull remote changes — a sync stopped partway or an account change ends at the next check; returns afterUploaded - beforeUploaded, which also counts sessions the pull re-marks as uploaded, so the logged 'pushed' figure is not only pushes.

Returns at once, stamping and logging nothing, when iCloud sync was turned off during the run (stopped for another account or deleted iCloud data, whose message stays). Otherwise, unless schemaUnavailable, sets syncState .error with the pull error or, failing that, the push error when either was recorded, else stamps lastSyncDate = now and sets .idle; logs the summary.

branches.effect: return; the stop message stays, lastSyncDate unchanged
